info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Delete Logistics Shipments Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Cancel Shipments API enables users to efficiently cancel logistics shipment orders. This operation is vital for managing shipping workflows, allowing businesses to quickly respond to changing circumstances or customer requests. Typical consumers of this API include logistics managers and order fulfillment operators who need to adjust shipment statuses proactively. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can enhance their operational flexibility and improve customer satisfaction through timely adjustments.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a specific shipment. It is essential to provide the correct shipment identifier to successfully process the cancellation request.

requestBody.description: Cancel an existing shipment. This request requires a JSON body containing the necessary information to identify and cancel the shipment.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling shipments.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.title: Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the shipment after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the cancellation.

audit.description: Audit information for the cancellation operation.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.description: Response schema for the cancellation operation of shipments.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains details regarding the audit of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing was instant.
